variants.name: A：作業時間を主役に
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-fidelity portrait iPhone screenshot proposing a beautifully redesigned end-of-work result modal for the lofi pixel-art focus app in the reference. Reference image role: exact visual reference for the existing app's city artwork, warm cream typography, understated glass materials and portrait composition. This is a NEW result state after work has finished. Preserve the recognizable detailed rooftop night-city illustration and small silver-haired girl working, warm lamp, greenery, blues and amber. NO phone hardware frame, no collage, no variant lettering inside the image, no extra decorative illustration.
The result is a native-style bottom sheet with large rounded top corners and a small single drag handle. Material MUST be translucent dark smoky navy frosted glass: scene silhouettes, neon city lights and warm table lamp must visibly show through the sheet, gently blurred; avoid a flat black or opaque gray panel. Legible warm ivory text, thin cream rules, careful spacing, very restrained contrast. Underlying work screen must be dimmed and inactive: no active stopwatch, no 作業中 badge, no pause/end controls visible; tab bar under the sheet is hidden. Top background title may remain faint. Keep scene visually dominant above and through modal.
Use SAME completed-growth example in all variants: heading おつかれさま, confirmed time 32分18秒, growth went from rank4 to rank5 and finished. Include exact text 今回の作業, この風景が完成しました, and 物語の続きを見る (small secondary text action), with ONE primary button 風景に戻る. Show five connected cream milestone dots and small 5/5 to identify the completed landscape. No upcoming-rank countdown, no scores, no coins, no streaks, no percentage statistics, no stars, no confetti, no trophies. Calm rewarding atmosphere, quiet sophisticated Japanese iOS UI, not gamified dashboard. Clean Japanese glyphs and realistic native controls.Layout A — balanced centered time-first design, bottom sheet takes roughly lower 56% of screenshot. Small centered heading おつかれさま near sheet top, small muted 今回の作業, then very large elegant serif 32分18秒 as clear hero with smaller minute/second units. Below a fine divider, a compact centered growth block: この風景が完成しました and the completed five-dot 5/5 row. Small secondary 物語の続きを見る. Wide warm-cream filled 風景に戻る button near bottom with generous side margins. No nested cards; one glass surface with a strong clean hierarchy.
